title: Test data must tell apart the fields a test claims to prove
rule: When a test asserts that a field is shown or copied, give that field a mock value that no other field on the same screen has, and locate it by its own label or accessible name. A value shared with another field (for example name ID 1 equal to the typographic family) makes the assertion pass even when the row is missing or bound to the wrong field.
rationale: E5.6 (#69): the mock face set legacyFamily/legacyStyle equal to familyName/style, so `toContain` and the `aria-label$=": Inter"` copy selector passed with the name ID 1/2 rows deleted.
